title: end of task labels named
name: End of task labels named
rule: End-of-task labels named: Done, Finish, Close, Got it, Dismiss (pick the one that matches the outcome).
pass_when: End-of-task uses one of Done / Finish / Close / Got it / Dismiss that matches the outcome.
fail_when: Generic OK, or a name that does not match the outcome (e.g. Dismiss when the task finishes a commit).
overview: End-of-task actions use Done, Finish, Close, Got it, or Dismiss by outcome.
apply_when: Naming the closing action after a Fluent task or teaching moment.
not_when: Primary commit verbs mid-task (Publish, Save) — those are not end-of-task dismissals.
agent_hint: Pick Done, Finish, Close, Got it, or Dismiss to match the actual outcome.
description: Fluent end-of-task labels are named from a fixed set: Done, Finish, Close, Got it, or Dismiss. Pick the one that matches the outcome the user just reached, not a generic stand-in. Apply when naming the closing action after a task or teaching moment. Fail generic OK, or a name that does not match the outcome — for example Dismiss when the task finishes a commit.
do_not_claim: `actions.copy.explicit_verb_not_ok` as a merge; Close vs Cancel keep-vs-abandon.
